problem: A salvaged low-voltage rover trips current limiting during startup. No real measurement exists. Choose an unpowered, read-only diagnostic first.

tests.description: Inspect housing color and case markings only
With all power disconnected, compare motor winding resistance and output-to-output resistance after removing motor leads from driver
Apply rated battery and attempt full motion without current measurements

problem: An unplugged FDM printer shows intermittent X-axis layer shifts. Select the most informative safe manual check before replacing components.

hypotheses.loose_pulley: Drive pulley has an unsecured grub screw
hypotheses.stepper_fault: Stepper electronics misdrive despite intact mechanical assembly

tests.description: With printer unplugged, inspect pulley fastening and belt tension across travel
Record filament color and spool type
Swap the stepper driver without mechanical inspection

problem: An unpowered donor controller does not respond to a BME280 breakout. No controller logic-voltage documentation is available. Which safe inspection best distinguishes candidate faults before direct connection?

hypotheses.wrong_pins: Signals wired to pins other than expected bus
hypotheses.incompatible_logic: Donor IO logic domain incompatible with sensor

tests.description: Inspect board markings, datasheets and unpowered pin continuity; verify declared voltage domains and bus pin identities
Change application sample rate without establishing bus compatibility
Attach unverified 5 V IO lines and turn on power

problem: Archived low-voltage rover logs show brownouts at movement start, but no bench measurements or physical controls are available. Choose one safe offline inspection of existing recorded data that best separates three causes.

hypotheses.supply_sag: The battery/rail collapses under actuator startup load
hypotheses.firmware_reset: Firmware deliberately restarts despite stable rail voltage
hypotheses.connector_drop: A loose supply connector creates an intermittent supply loss

tests.description: Read only the last boot reset reason from the archived diagnostic log
Align existing timestamped supply-rail voltage, connector-drop logs and firmware reset-cause events, without connecting new instruments
Inspect painted enclosure color from old photographs
Increase battery discharge current while moving the rover

problem: A hypothetical controller board has no UART text at boot. You have an archived schematic and existing captured trace files, but cannot probe or energize hardware. Choose one offline diagnostic to distinguish suspected causes.

hypotheses.pin_misroute: TX signal is connected to wrong header pin
hypotheses.baud_mismatch: Captured UART settings use the wrong baud

tests.description: Review TX net from MCU pad to header in schematic; no trace timing reviewed
Cross-check MCU-to-header TX net and archived logic-analyzer edge timing/activity against decoder settings
Read only the printed DC input-voltage label
Connect an unknown-voltage USB-UART cable and apply power
